page.title: Acceptance
page.subtitle: data set and test accounts
page.disabled: The acceptance kit is disabled on this environment
page.ownerRequired: Sign in with an owner account to open the kit

dataset.title: Data set
dataset.description: Two folders, eight presentations (one per status), five accounts, one invited account. Prefix {prefix}; the reset touches nothing else.

personas.anonymousHint: The pass remains valid to come back here.

editor.label: Global editor
editor.summary: Edits, publishes, changes the metadata. Neither access nor accounts.

viewer.label: Viewer without access
viewer.summary: Signed in with no access granted: public catalog only.

collab.label: Collaborator
collab.summary: Editor master key on the shared folder, read access on “Lecture seule”.

expired.label: Expired access
expired.summary: Master key expired yesterday: equivalent to a viewer without access.

anonymous.password: “Mot de passe” asks for “{password}” then opens.
anonymous.unlisted: “Non listée” opens through a direct link.

viewer.sharedFolder: The shared folder shows up empty.

collab.sharedFolder: Shared folder: “Publique”, “Mot de passe”, “Brouillon”, each with the pencil, and the “New presentation” button.
collab.sync: Editor of “Publique”: “Draft synced”; in a second tab, the typed text appears with the initial of the peer.
collab.pasteImage: An image pasted into the editor is inserted.
collab.unpublished: After a change, “Unpublished changes” in the header and on the card; “Publish” brings it up to date.
collab.password: “Mot de passe” opens without a password.
collab.readOnly: “Lecture seule” opens, with no pencil on its card.
collab.private: “Privée” is denied; no card offers metadata or sharing.

expired.catalog: Like the viewer without access: only “Publique” is visible.

editor.catalog: The whole data set, “Brouillon” included, with pencil and metadata.
editor.trash: The trash contains “Corbeille”, which can be restored.
editor.accountsDenied: The accounts page is denied; the sharing panels are read-only.

owner.accounts: Accounts: the five personas and the invited account “{handle}”.
owner.sharedFolderAccess: Access of the shared folder: collaborator (editor), expired access (expired), invited account (read). Change, add by email, remove.
